# MonsoonShield ⛈️

AI-powered water-borne disease early warning system for Coimbatore.
Real-time risk predictions, GAN-based extreme scenario simulation, and WebSocket live updates.

---

## 🚀 Quick Start

Ensure you have Python 3.10+ and Node.js v20+ installed.

```bash
# 1. Install dependencies
pip install "fastapi[standard]" "uvicorn[standard]" websockets uvicorn pandas scikit-learn prophet xgboost pydantic-settings python-multipart databases sqlalchemy aiosqlite httpx typer
cd frontend && npm install && npm run build && cd ..

# 2. Initialize the system (Creates DB, pulls NASA data, trains models)
python cli.py init

# 3. Start the entire system (FastAPI backend + React frontend proxy)
# Open 2 terminals:
python cli.py serve
python cli.py dashboard
```

*The dashboard will be available at `http://localhost:5173` and the API docs at `http://localhost:8000/docs`.*

---

## 🏗 Architecture

```mermaid
graph TD
    A[NASA POWER API] -->|Daily Sync| B(Data Orchestrator)
    C[OpenWeatherMap API] -->|Current Conditions| B
    B -->|SQL| D{SQLite Vector DB}
    
    D -->|Features| E[ML Engine]
    E --> F[Prophet Time-Series]
    E --> G[XGBoost Classifier]
    E --> H[CTGAN Simulation]
    
    F -->|Forecasts| I[FastAPI Backend]
    G -->|Risk Levels| I
    H -->|Synthetic Extremes| I
    
    I -->|REST API| J(React Frontend)
    I -->|WebSocket| J
    I -->|Alerts| K[Twilio / SendGrid]
```

---

## ⚙️ Environment Variables

Copy the `.env.example` file to `.env` if you need to override defaults.

| Variable | Description | Default |
|----------|-------------|---------|
| `OWM_API_KEY` | OpenWeatherMap Key (Required for live weather) | `""` |
| `MAPBOX_TOKEN` | Mapbox token (Optional, for 3D terrain) | `""` |
| `API_PORT` | Port for FastAPI to listen on | `8000` |
| `ENVIRONMENT` | One of `dev`, `staging`, `prod` | `dev` |
| `SMS_ENABLED` | Toggle Twilio SMS dispatch | `False` |

---

## 🛠 Command-Line Interface (CLI)

Use the built-in `cli.py` for all operations:

```bash
python cli.py --help

# Operations
python cli.py fetch-data --ward "Gandhipuram" --days 30
python cli.py train --ward all
python cli.py predict --ward "Peelamedu" --days 14
python cli.py simulate --ward "Gandhipuram" --scenario "100_year_flood"
python cli.py health
```

---

## 🩺 Troubleshooting

**Q: The map shows "Backend Offline".**
A: Ensure you have run `python cli.py serve` in a separate terminal and it is bound to port 8000.

**Q: "Model not found" error when predicting.**
A: Run `python cli.py train` to generate the `.json` XGBoost and Prophet models for the requested ward.

**Q: Empty database errors.**
A: Run `python cli.py init` to automatically create the schema and seed initial data.
